node.title: Re^2: Remove return on multiple lines between 2 characters
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
paragraph mode ... local $/ = " ";

Just wanted to point this out from [doc://$/]:

Setting it to " " means something slightly different than setting to "", if the file contains consecutive empty lines. Setting to "" will treat two or more consecutive empty lines as a single empty line. Setting to " " will blindly assume that the next input character belongs to the next paragraph, even if it's a newline.
